summary: Executed focused Phase-4 lifecycle validation using isolated TEST_ data on public preview URL. Backend lifecycle API test passed end-to-end (walk-in -> selection -> quotation -> ordered -> release -> operational follow-up auto-resolved) with idempotency and timeline checks. Mobile frontend smoke across Walk-ins/Customers/Quotations/Tile Orders/Follow-ups/Payments loaded successfully; one tile-orders tab regression observed.

critical.endpoint: Lifecycle criterion: Selection follow-up begin immediately after new Selection
critical.issue: Not provable in same-session TEST_ run because active automation cadence is DB-configured to start at day 2 for category `selection` (`reminder_offsets_days`: [2,4,7,10]). Newly created selection was advanced quickly to quotation/order before day-2 threshold, so no `selection_waiting` follow-up was generated in this run.

minor.issue: Observed delayed appearance of new automated cards during heavy reconcile churn; repeated reconcile + wait was needed before querying source_key in tests (likely due reconcile lock/skip behavior under concurrent triggers).

ui_bugs.issue: `Dispatch List` tab is visible again in UI screenshot. Prior redesign notes indicated old Dispatch List label/entry should be removed in favor of Customer/Brands/Material Movement Register flow.

integration_issues.issue: Operational follow-up lifecycle was verified via API assertions, but selection-stage reminder visibility depends on configured day offsets and elapsed time; immediate UI evidence is not available without waiting past offset or using pre-aged data.

react_native_issues.issue: Repeated warnings: `shadow*` deprecated to `boxShadow`, and `Animated useNativeDriver` fallback warning.

action_items: Decide expected behavior for Selection follow-up criterion: if it must begin immediately on selection creation, update automation rule semantics (currently day-2 minimum) or add a separate immediate handoff rule.
Re-check Tile Orders tab set in frontend and remove/rename `Dispatch List` if it is an unintended regression versus approved redesign.
Optionally review reconcile UX/telemetry for delayed card visibility under concurrent background reconcile triggers.
critical_code_review_comments: `workflow_transitions` path is correctly DB-configured and template-driven (no hardcoded operational message in follow-up creation path).
`followup_engine._operational_followup_producer` correctly ties auto-close to first release-material condition (`boxes_ready > 0` on resulting PO items).
Lifecycle test revealed that proving `selection_waiting` on fresh data is cadence-gated by `automation_rules.selection.reminder_offsets_days` and not an immediate event.

success_rate.frontend: Route/module smoke pass on mobile; 1 tab-label regression issue observed

rca_of_issue: RCA (selection-follow-up criterion gap): The follow-up engine intentionally gates `selection_waiting` by configurable day offsets from selection creation (`automation_rules.selection` default [2,4,7,10]). In a same-session E2E where selection is moved onward quickly, walk-in auto-resolves correctly but selection reminder does not yet exist. Mitigation: either accept delayed reminder semantics or introduce an immediate-on-selection operational nudge rule if business now requires instant start.
